---
title: Build with Hara
---
Move from the browser kernel into a local project, choose a host and editor,
then build a complete program using the same runtime-driven workflow.

## Set up a working environment

Start with [Install and choose a host](../getting-started.md), then continue with
the command line, Web, JVM, VS Code, or Emacs guide for your environment.

## Structure a project

[Projects and namespaces](../projects/index.md) covers manifests, source and
test paths, libraries, services, and publishing.

## Work against the running system

[Runtime-driven development](../concepts/runtime-driven-development.md)
explains the inspect, change, evaluate, and verify loop.

## Build a complete application

[Build Tic Tac Toe](../create/first-game.md) opens a dedicated course tree for
state, rendering, pointer input, live evaluation, and project files.
